faq_heading: Homes near Crescent Heights Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Crescent Heights Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Crescent Heights Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Crescent Heights Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Crescent Heights Academy, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Crescent Heights Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Langley Meadows Elementary (0.7 km east), Katzie Elementary (1.1 km north) and Latimer Road Elementary (1.1 km south-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Crescent Heights Academy

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Crescent Heights Academy in a straight line (14 elementary, 4 secondary, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is Langley Meadows Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Douglas Park Community, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Clayton Heights Secondary (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Bibleway Christian Academy (1.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunrise Ridge Elementary (1.9 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-12) is Bibleway Christian Academy, 1.9 km south-west of Crescent Heights Academy.
